name: Infinite Tower Tycoon
desc:
🏢 Welcome to infinite tower tycoon! 🏢
Build your amazing tower, earn money and get incredible potions and weapons!

How to play?
1- Claim a tycoon
2- Build conveyors and droppers to earn money 💰
3- Build walls and reach the highest level you can!

👍 Remember to like the game! 👍
Redeem the following codes for free cash (english version only):
